narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of south central, eastern and southeast Virginia.
ev: Water on roads was reported in and around Clarksville and western Mecklenburg county.
Tower Road was flooded in the vicinity of Route 58. All lanes were closed.
Water was covering roadways around Blackstone. One vehicle accident was related to high water and driving too fast.
Highway 202 (Cople Highway) was closed in both directions near Tavern Run Road. Between 4 and 5 inches of rain was reported in the area.
High water was reported on First Colonial Road.
Water was reported on a roadway and flooding the right lane.
